items.title: Norman Brownlee Interview, 1961-05-05
items.q: What was the name of this violin player that used to play out at Tranchinas years ago? Piron. Piron. I'll never forget, Piron recorded a number that an old friend of mine wrote.

ctx.x: And do you know Charlie Love? He's a trumpet player from all that college, you know what, anyway? I don't remember. He and Bocas made some records where Bocas plays the violin and Love plays the trumpet. And they played some of the Red Book ragtime arrangements like Maple Leaf and-

What was the name of this violin player that used to play out at Tranchinas years ago? Piron. Piron. I'll never forget, Piron recorded a number that an old friend of mine wrote. I used to write some tunes with him. Joe Burgess and- Oh, yeah. I know Joe Burgess. Jimmy Dupree. Jimmy Dupree and I used to write songs together.
Joe was still playing. I run into him once in a while.
